anchors.text: Release Coordinator sends a Signed Build to Change Approval before Authorized Deployment.
Authorized Deployment is owned by Platform Operations.
Case Archive retains closed evidence for 90 days before Review Archive.
Review Archive sends expired evidence to Certified Disposal.
Change Request is assessed by Impact Review before Customer Notice.
Customer Notice may be issued only after Change Authority approval.
Primary Responder hands an acknowledged incident to the Secondary Responder.
Secondary Responder records the handoff note before shift close.
Billing Exception goes to Revenue Review before Account Correction.
Account Correction is owned by Revenue Operations.
Submitter, Approver and Observer are the existing process roles.
Pending, Validated, and Archived are the existing lifecycle states.
Catalog Analyst submits Version 4 to Product Approver before Catalog Publish.
Only Version 4 is authorized for this edit.
When Evidence Retrieval is Unavailable, source-grounded generation is blocked while Manual Diagramming remains available.
Retry Retrieval may continue only after Evidence Retrieval is restored.
Field Request goes to Evidence Check. If Evidence complete? is Yes, Approve Request then Issue Work Order. If No, Request Missing Evidence then Await Resubmission.
Alert Received goes to Assess Service. If Service restored? is Yes, Record Resolution. If No, Start Recovery then Notify Incident Lead then Reassess Service.
Diagram Save Failed preserves the editable canvas and offers Retry Save.
After a repeated save failure, the agent routes the case to Storage Support.
